name: baccarat-playtech-min-width-full-length
label: Playtech — Min Width / Full Length
captureTarget: The result strip only — the smallest area that still shows the outcome.
ocrUse: Reads only the latest result. Fastest and least error-prone, but no card values.
notes: Best for small screens or a 125% display scale. Calibrate before trusting it. Playtech runs a wider table, so a half-width region may need to be wider. Run calibration with your casino window open before enabling OCR; this region is a starting point, not a measurement.
